title: Project：CLI 数据管理器 Milestone 3
objectives: 把持续演进的多文件 Project 组织成可复现的 CMake/CTest 目标图。
victoryConditions: clean configure、cli-data-manager target、CTest 和最终 CLI 集成测试全部通过。

starterFiles.CMakeLists.txt:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(cpp_learn_cli LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
add_library(record_model record.cpp store.cpp)
target_include_directories(record_model PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_executable(cli-data-manager main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cli-data-manager PRIVATE record_model)
enable_testing()
add_executable(record_store_tests tests.cpp)
target_link_libraries(record_store_tests PRIVATE record_model)
add_test(NAME record-store COMMAND record_store_tests --todo)

privateTests.name: repeatable clean build
privateTests.failureCategory: the named CMake target must remain usable after CTest

hints.title: 查看完整答案
